method: Whole4files manually read; pinned Git bytes compared. No GDI/UI execution.
findings: VisualizationPane owns3renderer windows and maps enum indices by static assertion. Switching hides/trims previous graph; hidden visualization trims active cache; all model updates forwarded to all renderer instances.

Suspension uses unsigned reference count: first suspend forwarded, nested requests retained, only final resume forwarded. Unmatched resume asserts and returns. Overflow and cross-thread calls unqualified; intended UI coordinated lifecycle.

TreeMapView prefers top-down32bit DIB for direct rendering with compatible-bitmap fallback; graph renderer DrawTreeMap receives current zoom model and options. No actual bitmap allocation/performance measurement.
Zoom uses4pixel frame and corresponding offsets for hover/selection hit geometry. HasValidLayout delegates renderer root validation, not content/source revalidation.

Extension highlights iterate visible leaf geometry; selected items filtered to current zoom ancestry and hardlink display mapping. Absent/invalid rectangles skipped; single-selection border may expand within client.
TreeMapView cache trim delegates ClearLayout and TrimMemory. Actual renderer allocation, layout/point correctness and performance remain unreviewed until TreeMap implementation inspected.
limits: No Windows rendering, memory accounting, resize/scan overlap, enum-fault or geometry runtime tests.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred.
